'''AdmiralThrawn36 Shredding People on Endor''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[AdmiralThrawn36]]
* '''Published:''' 12 November 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif|label=Endor Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Endor Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 EOps AdmiralThrawn36 DS 2002 Shreddin.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Basically, the main goal of this deck is to force drain like crazy in space. If need be it can work on the ground to. I think I’ve got enough ground but I need some suggestions about interrupts. Also, any suggestions about raising the destiny number- I’ve got a lot of ways to get extra destiny additions but it’s still a lousy average of a 2. Also, could you give me some suggestions for good systems for force draining? I think I’ve got good space power and especially Dengar can do some heavy damage against the light side tendency towards a large amount of ships in battles. Laser Cannons thrown in for kicks and destiny. Should I add Vader’s Light Saber to help drains on the ground?
